description: This file defines functions to load include patterns from environment variables and create a scoped Vitest configuration for extension diffs testing, and exports a default configuration.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads include patterns from the environment variable 'OPENCLAW_VITEST_INCLUDE_FILE' or returns null if not set.

methods.name: export function createExtensionDiffsVitestConfig( createExtensionDiffsVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a scoped Vitest configuration for extension diffs testing, using include patterns from environment or default roots.
